title: Hierarchical Curriculum Learning for Surgical Video Generation: Focusing on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach Robotic Thyroidectomy Datasets
title_zh: 外科手术视频生成的分层课程学习：聚焦于双侧腋乳入路机器人甲状腺切除术数据集

paragraphs.en: High-fidelity surgical video generation is increasingly important for surgical education, simulation, and downstream AI training, as conventional simulation pipelines are limited by cost, realism, and scenario diversity. Adapting generic text-to-video diffusion models to surgical procedures remains difficult, however, due to complex anatomical structures, intricate tool–tissue interactions, the inherently hierarchical nature of surgical workflows, and the scarcity of curated training data outside a few well-studied procedures. We propose a surgical video generation framework that combines hierarchical procedural annotation with curriculum transfer learning. Surgical procedures are decomposed into three levels (phase, task, and action) and a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model is progressively adapted from coarse to fine-grained surgical context, supported by a dynamic sampling strategy that handles variable-resolution and variable-length surgical clips. We instantiate the framework on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach robotic thyroidectomy, a procedure for which no curated benchmark currently exists. Relative to the preceding task-level model, the final action-level model reduces FVD by 20.1% and FID by 15.7%, and a matched-budget ablation indicates that these gains arise from the curriculum design rather than from additional training. A user study with six clinicians rates visual realism highly while highlighting remaining gaps in anatomical accuracy and clinical reliability. The proposed framework offers a step toward AI-driven surgical simulation in procedures where curated data are scarce.

paragraphs.en: Surgical simulation and computer-assisted training systems have become integral components of modern surgical education, allowing trainees to acquire technical skills in a risk-free, standardized, and objectively assessable environment, and decoupling the resident learning curve from patient risk [ 3 , 9 ] . The field has progressed from low-fidelity box trainers and cadaveric or animal models [ 37 ] to virtual reality (VR) systems that enable repeatable practice without spatiotemporal constraints, with growing evidence of its effectiveness in surgical training [ 33 , 35 , 27 ] . More recently, real surgical videos have emerged as a richer simulation source [ 6 ] , motivated by evidence that video-based curricula improve resident preparation and intraoperative participation [ 20 ] , and computer-assisted intervention approaches further combine deep models with surgical video to enable 3D reconstruction and immersive simulation [ 26 , 46 , 42 ] . Yet these approaches remain limited by the size and diversity of public surgical video datasets, which makes large-scale, scenario-diverse simulation difficult to extend across surgical disciplines.
paragraphs.zh: 手术模拟和计算机辅助训练系统已成为现代外科教育的重要组成部分，使受训者能够在无风险、标准化且可客观评估的环境中掌握技术技能，同时将住院医师的学习曲线与患者风险分离开来 [ 3 , 9 ] 。 该领域已从低保真度的箱式训练器和尸体或动物模型 [ 37 ] 发展到了虚拟现实（VR）系统，后者支持不受时空限制的重复练习，并有越来越多的证据表明其在外科训练中的有效性 [ 33 , 35 , 27 ] 。 近期，真实手术视频已成为更丰富的模拟资源 [ 6 ] ，这得益于相关证据表明基于视频的培训课程能够提升住院医师的准备水平和术中参与度 [ 20 ] ，而计算机辅助干预方法则进一步将深度模型与手术视频结合，实现了三维重建和沉浸式模拟 [ 26 , 46 , 42 ] 。 然而，这些方法仍受到公开手术视频数据集规模与多样性的限制，这使得难以将大规模、场景多样化的模拟扩展至不同外科学科。

paragraphs.en: Generative artificial intelligence has recently enabled high-fidelity synthesis across text, image, and video modalities [ 15 , 2 ] , with diffusion-based video models in particular emerging as the dominant paradigm due to their training stability, robustness to mode collapse, and high sample quality [ 10 , 15 ] . Modern text-to-video systems such as Sora [ 2 ] and Open-Sora [ 52 ] achieve high visual realism and temporal coherence on general-domain content, raising the prospect of AI-generated surgical videos as scalable training material, augmentation for downstream surgical AI, and a substrate for surgical planning. However, applying these generic video generation models directly to the surgical domain remains challenging. Surgical scenes contain complex anatomical structures, subtle tissue deformations, and intricate tool–tissue interactions, and surgical procedures inherently follow a hierarchical structure progressing from operational phases through intermediate tasks down to specific instrument actions. Generic text-to-video models often fail to capture this nuanced hierarchy, leading to temporal inconsistencies, physically implausible tool motion, and anatomical inaccuracies. Moreover, existing surgical video generation work has concentrated on procedures for which curated public datasets such as CholecT50 [ 31 ] or Kvasir-Capsule [ 40 ] already exist, leaving procedures with distinct anatomical access or instrumentation largely unaddressed.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能最近已实现了文本、图像和视频模态之间的高保真合成 [ 15 , 2 ]，其中基于扩散模型的视频模型因其训练稳定性、对模式坍缩的鲁棒性以及高样本质量而成为主导范式 [ 10 , 15 ]。 现代文本到视频系统（如 Sora [ 2 ] 和 Open-Sora [ 52 ]）在通用领域内容上实现了高度逼真的视觉效果和时间连贯性，这使得由 AI 生成的手术视频有望成为可扩展的训练材料、下游手术 AI 的增强数据以及手术规划的底层基础。 然而，将这些通用视频生成模型直接应用于手术领域仍然充满挑战。 手术场景包含复杂的解剖结构、细微的组织形变以及复杂的器械与组织相互作用，而手术过程本身则遵循一种层级结构：从操作阶段到中间任务，再到具体的器械动作。 通用文本到视频模型通常无法捕捉这种精细的层级关系，从而导致时间上的不一致、物理上不合理的器械运动和解剖学上的不准确。 此外，现有的手术视频生成研究主要集中在已有整理好的公共数据集（如 CholecT50 [ 31 ] 或 Kvasir-Capsule [ 40 ]）的手术程序上，而那些具有独特解剖学入路或器械使用方式的手术程序则基本未被涉及。

paragraphs.en: We focus on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach (BABA) robotic thyroidectomy as a representative example of such procedures. Thyroidectomy is among the most common endocrine surgeries worldwide, and BABA, a remote-access technique developed at Seoul National University Hospital [ 7 ] and later adapted to robotic surgery, provides an anatomically symmetric midline view that closely resembles the open surgical perspective [ 21 ] . BABA combines an abundance of high-quality intraoperative video with the absence of a curated public dataset, leaving it unexplored in recent surgical video generation research. This combination of rich raw footage and missing curated benchmarks makes BABA an ideal testbed for data-efficient adaptation of large pretrained video models to a new procedural domain.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将双侧腋乳入路（BABA）机器人甲状腺切除术作为此类手术的典型代表案例进行重点研究。 甲状腺切除术是全球最常见的内分泌外科手术之一，而 BABA 是一种由首尔国立大学医院 [7] 开发的远程操作技术，后被引入机器人手术领域。该技术可提供解剖学对称的中线视野，与开放手术视角高度相似 [21]。 BABA 拥有大量高质量的术中视频，但缺乏经过整理和公开的基准数据集，因此在近期的手术视频生成研究中尚未得到探索。 丰富的原始视频素材与缺失的标准化基准数据集这一组合，使 BABA 成为将大型预训练视频模型高效适配到新手术领域的理想测试平台。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in surgical workflow analysis suggest a path forward. Surgical procedures are inherently hierarchical, ranging from the entire operation down to phases, tasks, and actions, and recent works exploit this structure for surgical video understanding [ 49 , 50 ] . In parallel, curriculum learning, inspired by human learning, orders training data by difficulty and has been explored in medical image analysis [ 25 , 39 ] . However, while these advances enable richer surgical understanding, they have been applied almost exclusively to surgical analysis , with very limited exploration of how hierarchical procedural structure can be reflected in surgical video generation : the gap addressed by this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 手术工作流程分析领域的最新进展为未来研究指明了方向。 外科手术本质上具有层级结构，从整个手术过程到各个阶段、任务和具体操作层层递进，近期的研究正是利用这种结构来实现对手术视频的理解 [ 49 , 50 ] 。 与此同时，受人类学习启发的课程学习法通过按难度排序训练数据，已在医学图像分析领域得到探索 [ 25 , 39 ] 。 然而，尽管这些进展使手术理解更加深入，但它们几乎完全被应用于手术分析领域，而对如何将层级化的手术流程结构反映到手术视频生成中的研究却极为有限——这正是本文要填补的空白。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce a surgical video generation framework based on hierarchical annotation and curriculum transfer learning , with BABA robotic thyroidectomy as the target procedure. We construct a Phase–Task–Action three-level annotation of clinical BABA videos, and on top of the Open-Sora v1.2 architecture [ 52 ] , which combines a T5-XXL text encoder [ 34 ] , a 3D variational autoencoder (VAE), and a Spatial-Temporal Diffusion Transformer (STDiT), we fine-tune only STDiT through three progressive stages aligned with the annotation hierarchy. A dynamic bucket-based sampling strategy further enables efficient training on variable-resolution and variable-length surgical clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了一种基于分层标注和课程迁移学习的外科视频生成框架，并以 BABA 机器人甲状腺切除术为目标手术流程。 我们对临床 BABA 视频构建了“阶段–任务–动作”三级标注体系，并在 Open-Sora v1.2 架构 [52] 的基础上——该架构融合了 T5-XXL 文本编码器 [34]、三维变分自编码器（VAE）以及时空扩散变换器（STDiT）——仅针对 STDiT 进行微调，整个过程分为三个与标注层级对应的渐进阶段。 一种基于动态分桶的采样策略进一步实现了对分辨率和时长各异的手术片段的高效训练。

sents.en: To this end, we introduce a surgical video generation framework based on hierarchical annotation and curriculum transfer learning , with BABA robotic thyroidectomy as the target procedure.

sents.en: We construct a Phase–Task–Action three-level annotation of clinical BABA videos, and on top of the Open-Sora v1.2 architecture [ 52 ] , which combines a T5-XXL text encoder [ 34 ] , a 3D variational autoencoder (VAE), and a Spatial-Temporal Diffusion Transformer (STDiT), we fine-tune only STDiT through three progressive stages aligned with the annotation hierarchy.

paragraphs.en: Video generation has progressed rapidly with the rise of diffusion models [ 16 ] , after early efforts dominated by GAN-based approaches [ 30 ] . Video Diffusion Models (VDM) [ 16 ] first applied diffusion to video generation by extending the 2D U-Net used in image diffusion to a 3D U-Net, enabling unconditional and conditional generation while improving inter-frame consistency. Make-A-Video [ 38 ] introduced a strategy that augments a pretrained text-to-image model with additional spatial and temporal layers, enabling video synthesis without paired text–video data. Imagen Video [ 14 ] adopted a cascaded diffusion pipeline that first generates low-resolution videos and then performs multi-stage spatial and temporal super-resolution to reach high-definition output.
paragraphs.zh: 在扩散模型兴起之后，视频生成技术取得了飞速发展 [ 16 ]，而早期的研究则主要由基于 GAN 的方法主导 [ 30 ]。 视频扩散模型（VDM）[ 16 ]首次将扩散方法应用于视频生成，通过将图像扩散中使用的二维 U-Net 扩展为三维 U-Net，实现了无条件与有条件下的生成，同时提升了帧间一致性。 Make-A-Video [ 38 ]提出了一种策略，通过为预训练的文本到图像模型添加额外的空间和时间层，实现了无需配对文本–视频数据即可进行视频合成的能力。 Imagen Video [ 14 ]采用了一种级联扩散流程：首先生成低分辨率视频，然后执行多阶段的空间和时间超分辨率处理，最终获得高清输出。

paragraphs.en: More recent models emphasize temporal consistency and high-resolution generation. ART-V [ 45 ] introduces masked diffusion to enable autoregressive frame generation while maintaining temporal coherence over long sequences. Lumiere [ 1 ] uses a Space-Time U-Net (STUNet) to generate all frames jointly, replacing the keyframe-then-interpolate paradigm with a holistic low-resolution generation followed by super-resolution. OpenAI’s Sora [ 2 ] produces up to 60-second high-resolution ( 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 ) videos with complex multi-agent scenes, while Open-Sora [ 52 ] provides an open-source counterpart based on a Spatial-Temporal Diffusion Transformer (STDiT) and a 3D VAE, supporting up to 16-second videos at up to 720p with variable aspect ratios.
paragraphs.zh: 较新的模型更强调时间一致性和高分辨率生成。 ART-V [ 45 ] 引入了掩码扩散方法，实现了自回归帧生成，同时保持了长序列中的时间连贯性。 Lumiere [ 1 ] 使用时空 U-Net（STUNet）联合生成所有帧，用整体性的低分辨率生成加超分辨率处理取代了“先生成关键帧再插值”的传统模式。 OpenAI 的 Sora [ 2 ] 能够生成长达 60 秒的高分辨率（1920 × 1080）视频，其中包含复杂的多智能体场景；而 Open-Sora [ 52 ] 则提供了基于时空扩散变换器（STDiT）和三维 VAE 的开源版本，支持最长 16 秒、最高 720p 且宽高比可变的视频。

paragraphs.en: While these models achieve high realism on general-domain content, they do not encode the conceptual structure or domain-specific data required for highly structured procedural video, such as surgery, and thus cannot be applied directly to surgical video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些模型在通用领域内容上实现了高度逼真，但它们并未编码高度结构化程序化视频（如外科手术）所需的概念结构或领域特定数据，因此无法直接应用于手术视频的生成。

paragraphs.en: Surgical video generation poses unique challenges beyond those of general-domain video [ 48 ] , requiring high accuracy and realism for use in medical education and simulation [ 29 ] . Early work applied neural style transfer [ 11 ] , which combines content-feature reconstruction with texture synthesis, to enhance the realism of simulation-rendered images. SurReal [ 28 ] transferred the style of real surgical videos onto simulation renderings, preserving structural correctness while greatly improving visual realism. Real-time style transfer algorithms have also been proposed to improve the realism of laparoscopic surgical simulators while maintaining temporal smoothness [ 36 ] , applying the appearance of real surgical images to silicone-based phantoms.
paragraphs.zh: 手术视频生成带来了超越通用领域视频的独特挑战 [ 48 ]，需要极高的准确性和真实感，以用于医学教育和模拟 [ 29 ]。 早期的研究应用了神经风格迁移 [ 11]，该方法将内容特征重建与纹理合成相结合，以增强模拟渲染图像的真实感。 SurReal [ 28] 将真实手术视频的风格迁移到模拟渲染图像上，在保持结构正确性的同时显著提升了视觉真实感。 研究人员还提出了实时风格迁移算法，在保持时间平滑性的同时提升腹腔镜手术模拟器的真实感 [ 36]，将真实手术图像的外观应用于硅胶基假体。

[ 32 ] proposed a coherent texturing framework that generates tileable variable textures from intraoperative images and maps them onto 3D mesh geometry. More recently, MeshBrush [ 13 ] performs neural mesh stylization that preserves temporal consistency for endoscopic video by learning vertex-wise textures on meshes derived from patient imaging.

paragraphs.en: Beyond texturing and stylization, an emerging direction generates surgical videos directly. Endora [ 22 ] is among the first surgical video generation frameworks targeting endoscopic simulation, combining a latent diffusion model with a spatial-temporal video transformer and a DINO [ 4 ] feature prior that enhances inter-frame consistency. SurGen [ 6 ] is a text-guided diffusion model for surgical video synthesis built on CogVideoX [ 47 ] , generating 480p clips of 49 frames. SurgSora [ 5 ] extends this direction with a more controllable design that uses a single input frame and motion cues, comprising a Dual Semantic Injector, a Decoupled Flow Mapper, and a Trajectory Controller, and decoupling RGB-D features from optical flow. VISAGE [ 48 ] synthesizes laparoscopic surgical videos via action scene graphs whose nodes represent instruments and organs and whose edges represent the performed actions, capturing the spatial and relational dynamics of surgical activity through diffusion models. MedSora [ 43 ] integrates an attention-Mamba video diffusion backbone [ 12 ] , an optical-flow-based representation alignment module that enhances pixel-level inter-frame attention, and a frequency-compensated video VAE designed to reduce information loss for medical features. In ophthalmic surgery, Ophora [ 23 ] demonstrates that natural-language-guided ophthalmic surgical videos can be generated using a large dataset of more than 160K video–instruction pairs and a progressive video instruction tuning scheme that transfers spatiotemporal knowledge from general-domain pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: 除了纹理生成和风格化之外，一个新兴方向是直接生成手术视频。 Endora [ 22 ] 是最早针对内窥镜模拟的手术视频生成框架之一，它将潜在扩散模型与时空视频变换器以及 DINO [ 4 ] 特征先验相结合，以增强帧间一致性。 SurGen [ 6 ] 是一种基于文本的手术视频合成扩散模型，构建于 CogVideoX [ 47 ] 之上，可生成包含 49 帧的 480p 视频片段。 SurgSora [ 5 ] 通过更具可控性的设计扩展了这一方向，该设计仅使用单个输入帧和运动提示，包括双语义注入器、解耦流映射器和轨迹控制器，并将 RGB-D 特征与光流解耦。 VISAGE [ 48 ] 通过动作场景图合成腹腔镜手术视频，其中节点代表器械和器官，边代表执行的动作，从而通过扩散模型捕捉手术活动的空间与关系动态。 MedSora [ 43 ] 整合了注意力-Mamba 视频扩散主干网络 [ 12 ]、基于光流的表示对齐模块（用于增强像素级帧间注意力）以及频率补偿视频 VAE（旨在减少医学特征的信息损失）。 在眼科手术领域，Ophora [ 23 ] 表明，利用包含超过 160,000 个视频-指令对的大型数据集和渐进式视频指令调优方案（用于从通用领域预训练中迁移时空知识），可以生成由自然语言引导的眼科手术视频。

paragraphs.en: These advances have, however, concentrated on surgical domains for which curated datasets such as CholecT50 [ 31 ] and Kvasir-Capsule [ 40 ] already exist, leading to strong domain dependency and limited generalization. Procedures with distinct anatomical access and instrumentation, such as BABA robotic thyroidectomy, cannot directly benefit from these methods.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些进展主要集中在已有 CholecT50 [31] 和 Kvasir-Capsule [40] 等精选数据集的外科领域，导致其高度依赖特定领域且泛化能力有限。 具有独特解剖学入路和操作器械的手术流程（如 BABA 机器人甲状腺切除术）无法直接从这些方法中受益。

sents.en: These advances have, however, concentrated on surgical domains for which curated datasets such as CholecT50 [ 31 ] and Kvasir-Capsule [ 40 ] already exist, leading to strong domain dependency and limited generalization.
sents.zh: 然而，这些进展主要集中在已有 CholecT50 [31] 和 Kvasir-Capsule [40] 等精选数据集的外科领域，导致其高度依赖特定领域且泛化能力有限。

sents.en: Procedures with distinct anatomical access and instrumentation, such as BABA robotic thyroidectomy, cannot directly benefit from these methods.

paragraphs.en: Surgical procedures are inherently hierarchical, ranging from the entire operation down to phases, tasks, and actions. Recent works exploit this structure for surgical workflow analysis. HecVL [ 49 ] and PeskaVLP [ 50 ] pair short clips with atomic action descriptions, longer segments with phase summaries, and full videos with overall summaries, enabling models to capture both short-range and long-range dependencies and yielding strong representations for downstream tasks such as zero-shot phase recognition, with PeskaVLP further using LLMs to refine and augment these hierarchical texts.
paragraphs.zh: 外科手术程序本质上具有层级结构，从整个手术开始，逐级细化为各个阶段、任务和具体操作。 近期的研究利用这种结构对手术工作流程进行分析。 HecVL [ 49 ] 和 PeskaVLP [ 50 ] 将短片段与原子级操作描述配对，将较长片段与阶段摘要配对，并将完整视频与整体摘要配对，使模型能够捕捉短期和长期依赖关系，从而为下游任务（如零样本阶段识别）生成强大的表示；PeskaVLP 还进一步利用大语言模型来优化和扩展这些层级文本。

paragraphs.en: In parallel, curriculum learning has been explored in medical image analysis through progressive easy-to-hard schedules [ 39 ] and anti-curriculum selection of informative samples [ 25 ] . While these advances enable richer surgical understanding, they operate in a discriminative setting in which hierarchy guides representation learning for recognition rather than constraining a generative process. How hierarchical procedural structure should instead shape surgical video generation , where the model must synthesize, not classify, phase-, task-, and action-level content, remains largely unexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，课程学习已在医学图像分析领域得到探索，具体方法包括通过从易到难的渐进式安排 [39]，以及对信息丰富的样本进行反课程选择 [25]。 尽管这些进展使得对手术过程的理解更加丰富，但它们仍运行在一种判别性框架中：层级结构用于指导识别的表示学习，而非约束生成过程。 层级化的流程结构应如何塑造手术视频的生成——即模型需要合成而非分类各阶段、各任务及各动作层级的内容——这一问题在很大程度上仍未被探索。

paragraphs.en: This section details the proposed framework for surgical video generation. We first describe the construction of the hierarchically annotated clinical dataset, then introduce the network architecture, and finally present the dynamic bucket-based sampling and three-stage curriculum transfer learning strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细介绍了所提出的手术视频生成框架。 我们首先描述分层标注临床数据集的构建过程，接着介绍网络架构，最后呈现基于动态分组的采样方法以及三阶段课程迁移学习策略。

paragraphs.en: A total of 43 BABA robotic thyroidectomy videos were collected from Seoul National University Hospital. All patient identifiers were removed, and the data were stored and used in compliance with the institutional ethical guidelines.

paragraphs.en: To convert the structured surgical workflow into a form suitable for training, we adopt a Phase–Task–Action three-level Hierarchical Surgical Annotation Schema (Fig. 1 ). Phases are macro-level operational steps that modularize high-level surgical functions, tasks are intermediate clinical sub-goals reflecting surgeon judgment, instrument manipulation, and anatomical recognition, and actions are atomic micro-level units describing tool–motion–target interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将结构化的手术工作流程转换为适合训练的形式，我们采用了一种包含“阶段–任务–动作”三个层级的层次化手术标注方案（图 1）。 “阶段”是宏观层面的操作步骤，用于将高级手术功能模块化；“任务”是中间层级的临床子目标，反映了外科医生的判断、器械操作和解剖识别；而“动作”则是描述工具–运动–目标交互的原子级微观单元。

sents.en: To convert the structured surgical workflow into a form suitable for training, we adopt a Phase–Task–Action three-level Hierarchical Surgical Annotation Schema (Fig. 1 ).
sents.zh: 为了将结构化的手术工作流程转换为适合训练的形式，我们采用了一种包含“阶段–任务–动作”三个层级的层次化手术标注方案（图 1）。

sents.en: Phases are macro-level operational steps that modularize high-level surgical functions, tasks are intermediate clinical sub-goals reflecting surgeon judgment, instrument manipulation, and anatomical recognition, and actions are atomic micro-level units describing tool–motion–target interactions.

paragraphs.en: The Phase hierarchy is defined based on the six surgical modules of BABA robotic thyroidectomy proposed by Kim et al. [ 19 ] : midline incision to isthmectomy (MID), lateral dissection (LAT), preservation of inferior parathyroid glands (INF), recurrent laryngeal nerve and Berry ligament dissection (BER), superior pole dissection (SUP), and specimen removal and closure (END). The Task hierarchy is derived through cognitive task analysis of intermediate procedural goals within each phase. The Action hierarchy follows the action triplet representation ⟨ \langle instrument, verb, target ⟩ \rangle proposed by Nwoye et al. [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段层级是根据 Kim 等人提出的 BABA 机器人甲状腺切除术的六个手术模块定义的。 [ 19 ]：中线切口至峡部切除（MID）、侧方分离（LAT）、下甲状旁腺保留（INF）、喉返神经与 Berry 韧带分离（BER）、上极分离（SUP），以及标本取出与缝合（END）。 任务层级是通过对各阶段内中间程序目标的认知任务分析得出的。 动作层级遵循 Nwoye 等人 [ 31 ] 提出的动作三元组表示法 ⟨ \langle 器械, 动词, 目标 ⟩ \rangle。

sents.zh: 阶段层级是根据 Kim 等人提出的 BABA 机器人甲状腺切除术的六个手术模块定义的。

sents.en: [ 19 ] : midline incision to isthmectomy (MID), lateral dissection (LAT), preservation of inferior parathyroid glands (INF), recurrent laryngeal nerve and Berry ligament dissection (BER), superior pole dissection (SUP), and specimen removal and closure (END).

paragraphs.en: Annotations were performed by clinicians from the breast and endocrine surgery division of Seoul National University Hospital, who recorded start/end timestamps and textual captions at each level. As an exploratory methodological study, Task and Action annotations focused on the most generalizable End Phase (specimen removal and closure).
paragraphs.zh: 标注工作由首尔国立大学医院乳腺与内分泌外科分部的临床医生完成，他们在每个层级都记录了开始/结束时间戳和文本说明。 作为一项探索性方法学研究，“任务与动作”标注重点关注最具普适性的“最终阶段”（标本切除与缝合）。

paragraphs.en: Each video is segmented into clips along the Phase–Task–Action timestamps, then further split into fixed-length sequences of 120 frames at 24 FPS to balance training stability and surgical context. CSV-format metadata is generated for each sequence, mapping it to its caption and recording resolution, frame length, and aspect ratio for downstream sampling. Among the 43 cases, 4 were held out as a patient-level test set and the remaining 39 were used for training. At the Phase, Task, and Action levels, 20, 16, and 7 cases were annotated, respectively; after holding out the 4 test cases, 20, 12, and 7 cases remained for training. The per-level clip counts and training budgets are reported in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个视频都按照“阶段–任务–动作”时间戳分割成片段，然后进一步拆分为以 24 FPS 运行的固定长度 120 帧序列，以平衡训练稳定性与手术上下文。 为每个序列生成 CSV 格式的元数据，将其与对应的字幕、录制分辨率、帧长和宽高比进行映射，用于下游的采样。 在 43 个病例中，有 4 个被保留作为患者级别的测试集，其余 39 个用于训练。 在“阶段”、“任务”和“动作”三个层级上，分别标注了 20、16 和 7 个病例；在保留 4 个测试病例后，剩余可用于训练的病例分别为 20、12 和 7 个。 各层级的片段数量与训练预算如表 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: We adopt the Open-Sora v1.2 architecture [ 52 ] , an open-source Sora-like video generation model [ 2 ] , pretrained on more than 20M training samples with approximately 35,000 NVIDIA H100 GPU hours [ 17 ] . The model supports up to 16-second clips at resolutions from 144p to 720p, and contains ∼ \sim 1.1B parameters. The architecture comprises three modules (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用了 Open-Sora v1.2 架构 [ 52 ]，这是一种开源的类 Sora 视频生成模型 [ 2 ]，在超过 2000 万个训练样本上进行了预训练，训练过程消耗了约 35,000 个 NVIDIA H100 GPU 小时 [ 17 ]。 该模型支持最长 16 秒的视频片段，分辨率范围从 144p 到 720p，并包含约 \sim 11 亿个参数。 该架构由三个模块组成（图 2）。

sents.en: We adopt the Open-Sora v1.2 architecture [ 52 ] , an open-source Sora-like video generation model [ 2 ] , pretrained on more than 20M training samples with approximately 35,000 NVIDIA H100 GPU hours [ 17 ] .
sents.zh: 我们采用了 Open-Sora v1.2 架构 [ 52 ]，这是一种开源的类 Sora 视频生成模型 [ 2 ]，在超过 2000 万个训练样本上进行了预训练，训练过程消耗了约 35,000 个 NVIDIA H100 GPU 小时 [ 17 ]。

sents.en: The model supports up to 16-second clips at resolutions from 144p to 720p, and contains ∼ \sim 1.1B parameters.
sents.zh: 该模型支持最长 16 秒的视频片段，分辨率范围从 144p 到 720p，并包含约 \sim 11 亿个参数。

sents.en: The architecture comprises three modules (Fig. 2 ).
sents.zh: 该架构由三个模块组成（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Text Encoder. We use T5-XXL [ 34 ] to encode surgical text prompts (e.g., “robotic instrument grasping tissue during lateral dissection” ) into rich contextual embeddings that condition STDiT.
paragraphs.zh: 文本编码器。 我们使用 T5-XXL [ 34 ] 将手术文本提示（例如，“在侧向解剖过程中，机器人器械抓取组织”）编码为丰富的上下文嵌入，用于对 STDiT 进行条件约束。

sents.en: Text Encoder.
sents.zh: 文本编码器。

sents.en: We use T5-XXL [ 34 ] to encode surgical text prompts (e.g., “robotic instrument grasping tissue during lateral dissection” ) into rich contextual embeddings that condition STDiT.

paragraphs.en: 3D VAE. The Open-Sora v1.2 VAE compresses input videos into a low-dimensional spatiotemporal latent representation and decodes them back. It first compresses each frame spatially by a factor of 8 with a 2D VAE and then compresses the temporal dimension by a factor of 4 with a temporal VAE, producing more compact latents than a per-frame 2D VAE alone.
paragraphs.zh: 3D VAE。 Open-Sora v1.2 的 VAE 将输入视频压缩为低维时空潜在表示，然后再将其解码还原。 它首先使用 2D VAE 将每一帧的空间维度压缩 8 倍，接着使用时间 VAE 将时间维度压缩 4 倍，从而比单独使用逐帧 2D VAE 生成更紧凑的潜在表示。

sents.en: 3D VAE.
sents.zh: 3D VAE。

sents.en: The Open-Sora v1.2 VAE compresses input videos into a low-dimensional spatiotemporal latent representation and decodes them back.
sents.zh: Open-Sora v1.2 的 VAE 将输入视频压缩为低维时空潜在表示，然后再将其解码还原。

sents.en: It first compresses each frame spatially by a factor of 8 with a 2D VAE and then compresses the temporal dimension by a factor of 4 with a temporal VAE, producing more compact latents than a per-frame 2D VAE alone.
sents.zh: 它首先使用 2D VAE 将每一帧的空间维度压缩 8 倍，接着使用时间 VAE 将时间维度压缩 4 倍，从而比单独使用逐帧 2D VAE 生成更紧凑的潜在表示。

paragraphs.en: STDiT3. The core diffusion model operates in the latent space and learns conditional generation between text embeddings and video latents. To remain computationally tractable, STDiT decouples spatial and temporal attention: each block first applies spatial attention within frames, then temporal attention across frames, achieving efficient yet expressive spatiotemporal modeling. We adopt the STDiT3-XL/2 configuration: 28 28 blocks, hidden size 1152 1152 , 16 16 attention heads, patch size ( 1 , 2 , 2 ) (1,2,2) , and approximately 1.12 1.12 B parameters.
paragraphs.zh: STDiT3。 核心扩散模型在潜在空间中运行，并学习文本嵌入与视频潜在变量之间的条件生成。 为了保持计算上的可行性，STDiT 将空间注意力和时间注意力解耦：每个块首先对帧内应用空间注意力，然后跨帧应用时间注意力，从而实现高效且富有表现力的时空建模。 我们采用 STDiT3-XL/2 配置：28 个块、隐藏层大小为 1152、16 个注意力头、块大小为 (1, 2, 2)，以及约 1.12 B 的参数。

sents.en: STDiT3.
sents.zh: STDiT3。

sents.en: The core diffusion model operates in the latent space and learns conditional generation between text embeddings and video latents.
sents.zh: 核心扩散模型在潜在空间中运行，并学习文本嵌入与视频潜在变量之间的条件生成。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated the proposed framework on a patient-disjoint test set comprising 4 of the 43 BABA robotic thyroidectomy videos described in Section 3 . paragraphs.en: For quantitative evaluation, we report Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) [ 44 ] , Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) [ 51 ] , FloLPIPS [ 8 ] , Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) [ 41 ] , and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID). Surgical video generation is inherently non-deterministic: from a given prompt the model synthesizes a plausible realization rather than a pixel-aligned copy of any particular ground-truth clip. Reference-based pixel and patch metrics (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, FloLPIPS) therefore penalize legitimate appearance variation and, while reported for completeness, serve only as secondary frame-level indicators. We accordingly treat the distribution-level metrics FID and FVD, together with the clinical user study, as our primary measures, as they assess whether generated frames and videos match the real surgical distribution rather than a single reference clip.

paragraphs.en: For qualitative clinical evaluation, six clinicians (one resident and five fellows) rated the generated videos using a 5-point Likert scale [ 24 ] on visual similarity, anatomical accuracy, procedural consistency of motion, and overall quality. Inspired by the evaluation dimensions of VBench [ 18 ] , the questionnaire comprised seven items spanning general video quality (visual similarity, motion smoothness, imaging quality, aesthetic quality) and clinical relevance (human anatomy, clinical applicability, clinical reliability).

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports per-stage performance, focusing on the Stage 2 (Task) → \rightarrow Stage 3 (Action) transition. On our primary distribution-level metrics, Stage 3 reduces FID by 15.7% and FVD by 20.1% relative to the final Stage 2 model, indicating improved spatial and spatiotemporal realism. The secondary frame-level metrics move in the same direction but by smaller margins (PSNR + 5.6 % +5.6\% , SSIM + 1.2 % +1.2\% , LPIPS − 1.5 % -1.5\% ); FloLPIPS alone worsens slightly ( + 1.0 % +1.0\% ), which we attribute to its sensitivity to frame-to-frame flow differences under non-deterministic generation rather than to degraded temporal quality, a reading corroborated by the large FVD improvement on the same clips.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了各阶段的性能，重点关注阶段2（任务）到阶段3（动作）的过渡。 在我们的主要分布级指标上，与最终阶段2模型相比，阶段3将FID降低了15.7%，FVD降低了20.1%，表明空间与时空真实性得到了提升。 次要的帧级指标也呈现出相同趋势，但幅度较小（PSNR +5.6%、SSIM +1.2%、LPIPS -1.5%）；仅FloLPIPS略有恶化（+1.0%），我们认为这是由于其对非确定性生成过程中帧间流差异的敏感性所致，而非时间质量下降——这一解读得到了相同片段中FVD显著改善的证实。

paragraphs.en: Within Stage 2, FVD plateaued near 4100 and FID remained above 213, indicating that Task-only training had limited headroom. The frame-level scores fluctuated non-monotonically: SSIM dipped to 0.264 at 11k before recovering to 0.285 at 15k. We attribute this to the model generating sharper, more varied textures as training progresses; because such textures cannot match the ground-truth clip pixel by pixel, they can lower reference-based scores even when visual quality does not decrease. In Stage 3, the primary metrics improved overall: after an initial rise (4665.6 at 0.4k), FVD decreased to 3278.4 at 1.2k (a 29.7% reduction from the first Stage 3 checkpoint), and FID reached its minimum of 198.5 at 0.8k. These results indicate that Action-level fine-tuning improves fine-grained detail and temporal coherence beyond the Stage 2 plateau.

paragraphs.en: To verify that Stage 3’s gains stem from the curriculum rather than from additional training, we compared the full model (Stage 1 → 2 → 3 1\rightarrow 2\rightarrow 3 ) against a matched-budget baseline that spends the final 1.2k steps on Stage 2 data (Stage 1 → 2 → 2 1\rightarrow 2\rightarrow 2 ). Under an identical compute budget (Table 4 ), the curriculum model improves FVD by 18.0% alongside concurrent PSNR ( + 9.5 % +9.5\% ) and SSIM ( + 9.7 % +9.7\% ) gains, while LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and FID remain essentially unchanged. The simultaneous improvement in distribution-level (FVD) and pixel/structural (PSNR, SSIM) fidelity suggests that the improvement is not specific to a single metric. Notably, Stage 3 attains these gains from only 160 Action-level clips, 20 times fewer than the 3,200 Task-level clips used by the baseline, suggesting that, in this setting, curriculum ordering contributes more than additional Task-level data.

paragraphs.en: Visual inspection complements the quantitative findings. In early Stage 1 (15k steps), the model often produced physically impossible scenes such as three robotic arms appearing simultaneously, indicating that the basic constraints of the surgical environment had not yet been learned. By 35k steps, the arm count and motion errors were largely corrected, but textures of gauze and surrounding tissue remained blurred. By 55k steps, both physical constraints and fine textures (e.g., gauze fabric pattern, tissue surface) were faithfully reproduced (Fig. 6 ), suggesting that Phase-level training captures global surgical context.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉检查对定量研究结果起到了补充作用。 在早期阶段 1（15k 步）中，模型经常生成物理上不可能的场景，例如三个机械臂同时出现，这表明手术环境的基本约束条件尚未被模型掌握。 到 35k 步时，机械臂的数量和运动错误基本得到纠正，但纱布和周围组织的纹理仍然模糊不清。 到 55k 步时，物理约束和精细纹理（例如纱布的织物图案、组织表面）都得到了忠实再现（图 6），这表明阶段级训练能够捕捉到全局手术场景。

paragraphs.en: We also compared Stage 2 and Stage 3 models on specific Task prompts (Fig. 7 ). For suturing , Stage 2 captured rough shapes of needle and thread but rendered them ambiguously across frames, whereas Stage 3 produced sharper, more consistent thread contours and a clearer grasp on needle and thread. For irrigation , Stage 2 portrayed liquid sloshing and suction but with unnatural dynamics, while Stage 3 reproduced the inflow of liquid and surface specular reflections more realistically. These qualitative differences echo the quantitative gains in FVD and FID for Stage 3.

paragraphs.en: In addition to quantitative metrics, we incorporate a structured user study with practicing clinicians, enabling assessment of clinical reliability and anatomical accuracy beyond raw video quality. More importantly, our results show that a hierarchically structured curriculum extends high-fidelity generation to BABA robotic thyroidectomy without any curated benchmark, indicating that the approach is not confined to data-rich procedures targeted by prior work. By integrating hierarchical annotation with curriculum transfer learning, the framework treats surgery as a structured, hierarchical procedural domain rather than a flat sequence of frames, providing a path toward domain-specialized generative models with clinical relevance.
paragraphs.zh: 除了定量指标外，我们还纳入了与临床实践医生进行的结构化用户研究，从而能够评估超越原始视频质量的临床可靠性和解剖学准确性。 更重要的是，我们的结果表明，一种分层结构的课程能够将高保真生成扩展到 BABA 机器人甲状腺切除术中，而无需任何精心挑选的基准数据，这表明该方法并不局限于先前研究所针对的数据丰富的手术程序。 通过将分层标注与课程迁移学习相结合，该框架将手术视为一个结构化、分层化的程序领域，而非一个平行的帧序列，从而为开发具有临床相关性的领域专用生成模型提供了路径。

paragraphs.en: The quantitative results support this view: Action-level fine-tuning breaks the Stage 2 plateau, and the ablation (Table 4 ) shows the gain stems from the curriculum rather than extra training, as the matched-budget Stage 1 → 2 → 2 1\rightarrow 2\rightarrow 2 baseline lags despite using 20 × 20\times more clips.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果支持这一观点：动作层面的微调打破了阶段 2 的平台期，而消融研究（表 4）表明，这种提升源于课程学习而非额外的训练，因为预算匹配的“阶段 1 → 阶段 2 → 阶段 2”基准模型尽管使用了多 20 倍的剪辑片段，表现仍然落后。

paragraphs.en: Qualitatively, the progression of Stage 1 from physically implausible scenes (15k steps) to faithful textures (55k steps) suggests that Phase-level fine-tuning provides a foundation upon which Stage 2 and Stage 3 build with comparatively few additional examples. The Stage 2-vs-Stage 3 comparisons on suturing and irrigation suggest that Action-level training particularly benefits fine instruments and fluid dynamics, where temporal coherence is critical.

paragraphs.en: This study has several limitations. First, the dataset originates from a single institution (Seoul National University Hospital) with 43 BABA robotic thyroidectomy cases, so generalization to other institutions, surgical techniques, and patient populations is not directly demonstrated. Second, we focus on the End Phase for Task and Action annotation; modeling the entire procedure with consistent transitions between phases remains future work. Third, the absence of a public benchmark for surgical video generation prevents direct quantitative comparison with prior models; our evaluation is therefore relative to internal baselines. Fourth, while we employ standard quality metrics and expert review, we do not yet measure how generated videos affect actual training outcomes. Future work will integrate the system into existing training pipelines and quantify educational impact on residents and fellows.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究存在若干局限性。 首先，该数据集源自单一机构（首尔国立大学医院），仅包含 43 例 BABA 机器人甲状腺切除术病例，因此尚未直接证明其结论可推广至其他机构、手术技术或患者群体。 其次，我们专注于任务与动作标注的“结束阶段”；对整个手术流程进行建模，并实现各阶段之间的一致性转换，仍是未来的工作方向。 第三，由于缺乏用于手术视频生成的公开基准数据集，我们无法直接与先前的模型进行定量比较；因此，我们的评估仅基于内部基线模型。 第四，尽管我们采用了标准的质量指标和专家审查，但目前尚未衡量生成视频对实际训练结果的影响。 未来的工作将把该系统整合到现有的训练流程中，并量化其对住院医师和访问学者培训效果的影响。

paragraphs.en: We presented a framework for surgical video generation that combines a Phase–Task–Action hierarchical annotation system with a three-stage curriculum transfer learning strategy on top of the Open-Sora STDiT backbone, applied to BABA robotic thyroidectomy. Quantitative metrics, qualitative analysis, an ablation study, and a clinician user study collectively show that the framework adapts a large pretrained model to domain-specific surgical content and improves fine-grained visual fidelity while preserving global procedural context. Although validated on a single procedure, the approach may extend to other procedures and offers a basis for AI-driven surgical simulation, education content generation, and downstream surgical AI systems requiring high-fidelity synthetic video.
